models.name: Whisper Tiny (English)
models.description: Fastest, lowest accuracy. Good for older machines and phones.
models.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights, whisper.cpp ggml conversion)

models.name: Whisper Base (English)
models.description: Good balance of speed and accuracy for most laptops.
models.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights, whisper.cpp ggml conversion)

models.name: Whisper Small (English, compact)
models.description: About 25% fewer wrong words than Base on our synthetic test speech, and 2 to 3 times slower. Quantized to 5 bits to keep the download small.
models.license: MIT (OpenAI Whisper weights, whisper.cpp ggml conversion)

models.name: Gemma 3 1B (fast)
models.description: About 1.5 times faster than Gemma 4 E2B and under 1 GB of memory, but its hints are more generic and its notes repeat themselves more.
models.license: Gemma Terms of Use (Google Gemma 3, GGUF conversion by Unsloth)

models.name: Gemma 4 E2B
models.description: The default: good hints and notes, about 4 GB of memory while loaded.
models.license: Apache-2.0 (Google Gemma 4, GGUF conversion by Unsloth)

models.name: Gemma 3 4B
models.description: Larger and about 2 times slower than Gemma 4 E2B. In our test its notes were not clearly better, so it is offered as an alternative, mainly for notes.
models.license: Gemma Terms of Use (Google Gemma 3, GGUF conversion by Unsloth)
